annotation.title_clean: ISO 18646-2:2024 Robotics — Performance criteria and related test methods for service robots — Part 2: Navigation
annotation.title_en: ISO 18646-2:2024 Robotics — Performance criteria and related test methods for service robots — Part 2: Navigation
annotation.summary_en: ISO catalogue page for ISO 18646-2:2024 (Edition 2, ISO/TC 299). The standard sets methods for specifying and evaluating the navigation performance of mobile service robots in indoor environments: pose accuracy, repeatability, obstacle avoidance, path deviation, narrow passages and mapping accuracy. It explicitly excludes verifying safety requirements.
key_provisions_or_claims: Measures navigation performance by pose accuracy and repeatability, obstacle detection and avoidance, path deviation, narrow passage and mapping accuracy
Applies only to mobile platforms in contact with the travel surface; ISO 9283 covers manipulators
Covers indoor environments, with Annex A on applying the tests outdoors
Not applicable to verifying or validating safety requirements
Replaces ISO 18646-2:2019; the page lists a systematic review stage
